title.narrative: Promoting Small Biomass Power Plants in Rural Thailand for Sustainable Renewable Energy Management and Community Involvement

description.narrative: The aim of proposed project is to promote on-grid small scale biomass gasification power plants as the means of sustainable management and use of biomass in rural Thailand. The project will establish and demonstrate technical and financial viability of an on-grid small scale biomass gasification power plant, increase entrepreneurial capacity and the capacity on project development, operation and management of small scale biomass gasi fication power plants. A distinctive component of the project is the development of a comprehensive information site or learning centre for small scale biomass gasification power plants which will train interested project developers for embarking a similar initiative and scaling up the project nationwide. Experience gained and lessons learnt from the project will be collated and used for policy recommendations to facilitate and promote the spreading and replication of small scale biomass gasification power plants in Thailand. The project will also build capacity in fuel management aspects.The project will overcome the key barriers that exist for the development of small scale biomass gasification power plants in Thailand.
